# Circulation supervisors meeting, 2026-02-25

Branch circulation supervisors met to prepare for a possible board vote on [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]].

- If the board votes yes, every account balance made up only of late charges gets cleared in one batch on April 1. [[Ines Barrow]] will run it; see [[How to clear old late charges from patron accounts#Blocked cards]].
- Desk staff want a short script for patrons who already paid this year and ask for refunds. The answer is no refunds; the wording goes in [[Talking points for patrons]].
- Replacement charges for lost items stay, per [[Decision - Keep replacement charges for lost items]].
